name: Kraken BTC/USD level-two order-flow imbalance
description: Standard best-quote event order-flow imbalance over completed atomic Kraken level-two delta groups. Bid contribution adds current size when bid price is unchanged or improves and subtracts prior size when unchanged or worsens; ask contribution subtracts current size when ask price is unchanged or improves and adds prior size when unchanged or worsens. Positive output represents net bid-side pressure and negative output net ask-side pressure, in BTC base units, over causal 1-, 10-, and 60-second receipt-time windows of (window close minus duration, window close]. Snapshots establish baselines and contribute no flow. Ready output requires 60 seconds of uninterrupted Kraken observation measured from a complete snapshot after startup or recovery, and Kraken demonstrably alive. An eventless book window on a live Kraken connection — any admitted Kraken input event within staleness_bound_ms — publishes truthful zero imbalance; no admitted Kraken input within that bound keeps degrading as book_snapshot_stale_or_missing, and a crossed, invalid, or unsnapshotted Kraken book still degrades. This identity is single-venue: it reads only Kraken inputs and is ready whenever Kraken is warmed and alive and its book is valid, independently of the other adopted spot venue. The blended `btc.external.*` reading of the same measurement stays the reference layer and continues to require every adopted venue (ADR 0024). Decimal outputs are rounded to eight places using round-half-to-even.
